items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So I said, “Well, you ought to come and make a record with me if he fired you.” And he did.

ctx.x: George was with Columbia. John Hammond fired him, and George... I knew it. I used to see George all the time. So I said, “Well, you ought to come and make a record with me if he fired you.” And he did. Lonnie was in his band so I got both of them at the same time.
Anything else you’d care to say about how you addressed things with this band?
